The challenger's own absence_auc is statistically indistinguishable from chance (pooled 0.5029, 90% CI [0.4830, 0.5235] — includes 0.5); the positive delta (+0.0278) exists only because the incumbent rest/schedule/minutes-trend baseline scores BELOW chance (0.4751) at its preregistered fixed orientation. At the 1-per-100 alert threshold the challenger detects 4 of 200 absence events (2.0% event recall) with 5.2% row precision against a 4.5% base rate. Promotion was never on the table: quarantined, and ROADMAP W6 requires prospective performance — there is no retrospective correlation here to footnote. This kills the W6 micro-signal v1 cheaply, which is what the quarantine queue is for.
results.method: absence_auc is a set-level rank statistic; per-game paired residuals do not exist for it, so compare_to_incumbent()'s per-game loss contract cannot host the primary metric. Recorded via registry.evaluate() — the harness's documented path for evaluations produced outside compare.py (registry.py docstring). Gates computed here against the preregistered thresholds in compare.py's orientation: delta = challenger_auc - incumbent_auc (higher-better, positive = improvement); CIs from a seeded game-date-clustered percentile bootstrap recomputing AUC per replicate (n_boot=2000, seed=20260730, level 0.90), matching compare.py's primary clustering; team-clustered sensitivity CI alongside.

features_desc: THE RULE. For a battery of m tests controlled at false-discovery rate q, the smallest attainable permutation p-value is 1/(B+1); the smallest BH threshold is q/m. A screen is RESOLUTION-CAPABLE only if 1/(B+1) <= q/m, i.e. B >= m/q - 1. Every screen must (a) compute m before running, (b) set B >= m/q, (c) REFUSE TO START and report the required B if the budget cannot meet it, and (d) print the resolution-capability check in its report. Worked examples: m=297 at q=0.10 needs B >= 2,970 (run 1's B=200 was resolution-incapable - its 32 BH passes survived only because 32+ tests tied at the floor and cleared at higher ranks, which is luck of tie-count, not power); m=1,368 needs B >= 13,680 (the volume screen's B=200 could never certify anything). ADAPTIVE ESCALATION, revised: baseline B = max(2,000, ceil(m/q)); any test reaching p < 10*q/m escalates to B = max(20,000, ceil(10*m/q)) before any decision is read. RETROSPECTIVE CONSEQUENCE: every completed screen must be re-checked against this rule and labelled resolution-capable or resolution-limited in the lab manual. Screens found resolution-limited have their nulls VOIDED (they certify nothing) while their EFFECT SIZES and detection limits remain valid and reportable - a distinction the manual must show explicitly.

features_desc: P2-CORRECTION - THE PERMUTATION RULE IS A POLICY, NOT A NECESSITY. B >= m/q - 1 guarantees only that a SINGLE rank-one BH discovery is attainable. BH can validly reject at higher ranks when several tests share the minimum discrete p-value. The rule is therefore RENAMED the SINGLETON-RESOLUTION GUARANTEE and retained as a conservative laboratory standard; the phrase 'a screen is resolution-capable only if' is WITHDRAWN as too absolute. CONSEQUENTLY: the characterisation of run 1's 32 BH passes as 'tie-count luck rather than power' is WITHDRAWN - those rejections are valid under BH's own logic given the p-values it was handed. Run 1 warrants a re-run because (a) its row-exchangeable null was anti-conservative for clustered features and (b) its p-values were coarse - NOT because resolution invalidates its BH results. The numerical diagnosis of the 1,368-test screen stands: with only 20 minimum-p tests against a required 69, none could pass its realised battery. P3-CORRECTION - ADAPTIVE ESCALATION AS REGISTERED IS INVALID AND IS WITHDRAWN. Selecting tests for 20,000 permutations after seeing their first-2,000 results distorts the p-values of exactly the tests selected. Replacement: a FIXED FINAL PERMUTATION COUNT B_final = max(2,000, ceil(m/q)) applied to EVERY potentially rejectable test, with early stopping permitted ONLY when a valid bound proves rejection is impossible (e.g. once the accumulated exceedance count makes the attainable p exceed the largest BH threshold q, that test may halt). Any genuinely sequential design must be preregistered with sequentially valid bounds; none is in use. P5-CORRECTION - 'SEVEN EXPERIMENTS HAVE NO PLACEBO' IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY A DEFECT and the uniform framing is withdrawn. A clean out-of-sample comparison with paired clustered inference does not always require a permutation placebo; it is required where the registered charter demands one, or where fitting or selection needs a negative control. Individual classification, binding: NEEDS-A-NEGATIVE-CONTROL (fits and selects parameters on train, claims an incumbent comparison) = bottomup_3pt (tunes rate alpha, shrinkage K, team-trend alpha), w4_refs (tunes pooling K), totals_head (fits a,b,c AND selects the environment spec), w2_integration (fits calibration; separately affected by the full-sample K table). BORDERLINE, review case-by-case = dist_margin_cover (fits only a single train moment, sigma, plus empirical quantiles). NOT-REQUIRED (no fitted or selected parameter) = totals_online (K=15 a priori), clv_transfer (pure measurement study). Adding a negative control to bottomup_3pt is the highest-value remediation. P1-CORRECTION - MDE REPORTING DISCIPLINE. No report may present an effect exceeding its MDE as evidence of a real effect. MDE is a property of the design, not of the effect. Every effect claim must cite a calibrated permutation p-value or a confidence interval; where a screen produced neither, effects are labelled CANDIDATE and nothing stronger.

features_desc: C1 - SELF-CONTRADICTION IN v4, CORRECTED. v4 downgraded the block-vs-row null-width figures to UNVERIFIED and then, in the same record, justified re-running run 1 because its null 'was anti-conservative'. Anti-conservatism is a HYPOTHESIS, not a measurement, until the diagnostic is committed with repetitions, uncertainty and the exact block construction. BINDING WORDING from here: the row-exchangeable null is STRUCTURALLY INAPPROPRIATE for clustered data (a design fact, independent of any measurement) and is SUSPECTED ANTI-CONSERVATIVE (an unverified hypothesis). Run 1 warrants re-running on the structural ground plus coarse p-values; the magnitude of any anti-conservatism is unknown. C2 - THE STOPPING RULE, MADE UNAMBIGUOUS. 'Every potentially rejectable test' is withdrawn: it re-admitted the adaptivity v4 removed, because a test cannot become potentially-rejectable on the basis of preliminary results. BINDING: EVERY REGISTERED TEST BEGINS UNDER THE SAME PREDETERMINED B_final = max(2,000, ceil(m/q)), fixed before the first draw. The ONLY permitted early stop is a validity-preserving impossibility bound: with e exceedances observed so far, the final permutation p-value can be no smaller than (1 + e) / (B_final + 1); once (1 + e) / (B_final + 1) > q, rejection is impossible even if every remaining draw is favourable, and that test may halt. Comparison is against q because q is the largest BH threshold (rank m). The bound is evaluated INDEPENDENTLY UNDER EACH REQUIRED NULL (player-season blocked, game-date blocked), and a test halts only when the bound holds under the null being evaluated; the decision still uses the most conservative null per v2. Reports must print B_final, the per-test exceedance counts, and which tests halted early under the bound. C3 - PROVENANCE: THE FAILED FLIP IS A MIGRATION SPEC, NOT A LICENCE TO KEEP THE UNSAFE DEFAULT. v4's framing is corrected. The required migration, now specified: (a) split pure metadata comparison into assert_asof_metadata(manifest, decision_cutoff) - no file access, no hashing - which the date-logic tests use; (b) the PRODUCTION entry point assert_asof() defaults verify_hash=True and FAILS CLOSED on a missing manifest or artifact; (c) the module's synthetic tests create TEMPORARY ARTIFACTS with valid manifests rather than referencing files that do not exist; (d) builders emit manifests carrying dependency hashes, config hash, producer commit and data-snapshot hash, with fit_through recorded as WHEN THE SOURCE INFORMATION BECAME AVAILABLE, not the game date; (e) consumers compare against the DECISION CUTOFF, never tip time. C3-BLOCKING - PROMOTABILITY BAR, EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY. build_rapm_walkforward_v1 and player_feature_rebaselined_v1 (both in flight at the time of this registration) MAY NOT BECOME PROMOTABLE CONSUMERS until every critical fitted artifact they consume or produce carries a manifest satisfying (d). Their results may be COMPUTED, RECORDED and DISCUSSED during the enforcement gap, but may not be cited in support of any promotion, nomination, or model-freeze decision until the bar is met. This prevents new results from quietly accruing legitimacy while enforcement is acknowledged as absent. C4 - LANGUAGE ON PRIOR BH OUTPUTS. Results from screens whose null is structurally inappropriate and whose dependence assumptions are unresolved are to be described as 'rejections produced by the BH procedure', NOT as 'valid FDR-controlled discoveries'. The distinction is binding in every report and in the lab manual: the algorithm ran and emitted rejections; whether they control the false-discovery rate depends on the validity of the p-values fed to it, which is unresolved for run 1.

extra.why_this_matters: the betting layer does not need a model that beats the market on average - it needs to know where it is right. features_desc: TARGET: signed edge_g = |market_margin - true| - |model_margin - true| per game (positive = we beat the market). Secondary target: sign(edge_g) as a classification. MODEL: ridge / logistic on standardised pregame features, walk-forward by season, fit on earlier seasons only. FEATURES - EVERY ONE MUST BE KNOWABLE AT THE DECISION CUTOFF (this is the discipline that makes the study meaningful; the post-hoc absence count that motivated it is BANNED): pregame absence load from the captured injury reports and, for the retrospective era, the count of players on the recency roster who did NOT appear in the team's previous game (a strictly-prior proxy - its correlation with the post-hoc count is reported so the proxy's quality is visible); rest days and rest differential; each team's games played; the market line magnitude and the cross-book line dispersion at cutoff; number of books quoting; market total; our model's own predicted margin magnitude; our predicted total; the model's channel-level disagreement (spread across the four channels); expansion-team flag; season phase; days since each team's last meeting; and the |model - market| disagreement itself. DISCIPLINE: walk-forward (fit 2022-2024, validate 2025, hold 2026); date-clustered bootstrap CIs; a block permutation null on the target; B_final per amendment v5's singleton-resolution rule with the impossibility-bound stop; BH q=0.10 as the sole decision rule; MDE reported on every null. THE PAYOFF TEST (the only result that matters): rank validation games by PREDICTED edge, take the top decile / quartile / half, and report realised mean edge and flat-stake ROI at -110 and at captured prices in each bucket, with CIs and bet counts. A selection rule that cannot turn predicted edge into realised edge is a failure regardless of in-sample fit.
hypothesis: John's question 2026-07-31: 'the question is not does it beat the market but can it predict the times it does'. Hypothesis: our signed edge over the market (market absolute error minus model absolute error, per game) is PREDICTABLE BEFORE TIP from pregame-knowable features - so that selecting a subset by predicted edge produces positive realised edge and positive flat-stake ROI on games outside the selection fit. This is the ROADMAP's 'conditional edge calibration', never previously built. It is the correct target because the betting rule only requires knowing WHERE we are right, not being right on average.

features_desc: C2 - OUT-OF-FOLD BASE PREDICTIONS (the genuine gap, with a consequence). The selector must train on base-model predictions that were generated out-of-fold and chronologically, or it learns from residuals of a model fitted on the same games. PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCE, stated because it constrains the study: experiments/channel_reval/predictions_v2.csv contains ONLY the 673 walk-forward TEST games (2024/2025/2026). Seasons 2021-2023 are the base model's TRAINING window, so their predictions would be in-sample and are THEREFORE UNAVAILABLE as selector-training data. The registered 'fit 2022-2024' instruction is WITHDRAWN as unsatisfiable. Binding split: SELECTOR-TRAIN = 2024 (out-of-fold base predictions, ~229 games / ~1,800 prop player-games), SELECTOR-VALIDATE = 2025, HELD OUT = 2026. The thin selector-train sample is a REAL limitation and must be stated in the report alongside the resulting uncertainty; if the agent wishes to enlarge it, generating genuine out-of-fold 2022-2023 base predictions is a separate registered build, not an inline improvisation. C3 - COMPARATORS, FIXED IN ADVANCE. Feature list, bucket boundaries (top decile / quartile / half), betting thresholds and stopping rules are already frozen; ADDED as mandatory reference arms, evaluated identically and reported side by side with the selector: (i) NO SELECTION (bet everything), (ii) ABSOLUTE MODEL-MARKET DISAGREEMENT alone as the ranking score, (iii) THE ABSENCE PROXY alone as the ranking score. The selector must beat all three on the validation slice to be interesting; beating none of them while fitting well in-sample is the expected failure mode and must be reported as such. C5 - LINE DEPENDENCE. Multiple books quoting the same player-game are NOT independent observations. PRIMARY analysis nominates ONE executable line-selection rule in advance: the BEST AVAILABLE PRICE at the decision cutoff for the chosen side, one bet per (player, market, game) - which is also what a bettor would actually do. The multi-book view is a SENSITIVITY only, and when reported must use THREE-WAY clustering (player, game/date, book), not the two-way clustering originally registered. Game-level sides likewise: one bet per (game, market) at best available price. C6 - PAYOFF AND COVERAGE TOGETHER. Every bucket must report: opportunities ACCEPTED (count and share of available), comparative error within the bucket, flat-stake ROI after ACTUAL captured prices and vig (the -110 synthetic figure is secondary), date-clustered uncertainty intervals, and a RISK-VERSUS-COVERAGE CURVE - realised ROI and its CI plotted against the share of opportunities accepted, so a tiny profitable bucket is visibly distinguished from a robust one. A bucket with fewer than 50 independent bets is reported descriptively and never starred. ALREADY FROZEN, confirmed by audit and restated for the record: C1 the target is REALISED COMPARATIVE PERFORMANCE (|market error| - |model error|), never disagreement size, and the report must state what share of predicted-edge variance is explained by the disagreement term; C4 every selector input must be reproducible as of the exact betting cutoff, the post-hoc absence count is BANNED as a feature, and its correlation with the pregame proxy is a DEVELOPMENT DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, never a justification; C7 retrospective results are CANDIDATE GENERATION - promotion requires the FROZEN selector to identify opportunities prospectively in the live log, as preregistered paper-trade cells.

results.target_defect: TARGET-DESIGN DEFECT, handed back by the build and accepted: the selector reduces to the model-market disagreement term, INVERTED. 88.4 percent of props predicted-edge variance is |projection - line| alone (r = -0.940); 26.4 percent at game level (r = -0.513). The learned rule is not 'bet when we disagree' but 'bet where we AGREE with the line'. This is FORCED, not discovered: by the reverse triangle inequality |edge| <= |projection - line|, so small disagreement mechanically bounds comparative error near zero, and because unconditional mean edge is negative, agreeing scores well on the registered target. THE REGISTERED TARGET IS THEREFORE MAXIMISED BY FINDING ROWS WHERE WE HAVE NOTHING TO SAY - it rewards abstention, not skill. A successor must target realised RETURN directly, or fix a disagreement band BEFORE ranking. The opposite direction also fails, as clv_transfer predicted: disagreement-alone top decile realises edge -1.64, ROI -21.8 percent.

But it sits on a FLAT ROI curve, and EVERY ROI statistic halted under the impossibility bound. Ranking comparative accuracy is achievable; converting it to return is arithmetically excluded by these data.
results.why: TARGET-DESIGN DEFECT, handed back by the build and accepted: the selector reduces to the model-market disagreement term, INVERTED. 88.4 percent of props predicted-edge variance is |projection - line| alone (r = -0.940); 26.4 percent at game level (r = -0.513). The learned rule is not 'bet when we disagree' but 'bet where we AGREE with the line'. This is FORCED, not discovered: by the reverse triangle inequality |edge| <= |projection - line|, so small disagreement mechanically bounds comparative error near zero, and because unconditional mean edge is negative, agreeing scores well on the registered target. THE REGISTERED TARGET IS THEREFORE MAXIMISED BY FINDING ROWS WHERE WE HAVE NOTHING TO SAY - it rewards abstention, not skill. A successor must target realised RETURN directly, or fix a disagreement band BEFORE ranking. The opposite direction also fails, as clv_transfer predicted: disagreement-alone top decile realises edge -1.64, ROI -21.8 percent. Top-decile mean |projection - line| is 0.31 points vs 1.79 overall, and the hit rate is 49.2 percent - a coin flip paying vig.

features_desc: TARGET (what the model learns): P(outcome > line) per player-market-game — a binary, low-noise, well-posed label — NOT realised return and NOT comparative error. SCORING (how the probability is judged): log loss, Brier score, and an explicit CALIBRATION assessment (reliability table plus calibration slope/intercept). A probability that is not calibrated is not usable downstream, regardless of discrimination. DECISION (how bets are formed): expected value computed from the calibrated probability and the ACTUAL EXECUTABLE ODDS at the cutoff; bet only where EV exceeds a threshold FIXED IN ADVANCE. EVALUATION (how the policy is judged): realised ROI, coverage, and clustered intervals on the frozen rule. MANDATORY DEFENCES AGAINST THE KNOWN TRAP (tests/test_edge_target_identity.py): (1) a MINIMUM DISAGREEMENT BAND fixed before any result is viewed, with a MEANINGFUL floor stated in points, so the selector cannot optimise toward rows where the model has no independent opinion; (2) OVERS AND UNDERS EVALUATED SEPARATELY, never pooled, since the trap and the vig can act asymmetrically; (3) the report must state what share of the decision is explained by |projection - line| and demonstrate the agreement trick does not win. EXECUTABILITY, per review point 8 and now mandatory: prices must be verified SIMULTANEOUSLY LIVE via last_update, staleness excluded, book limits applied, duplicate and alternate markets handled consistently, side selection fixed, and the count of INDEPENDENT PLAYER-MARKET OPPORTUNITIES reported rather than quoted rows. POWER, per review point 3 and now mandatory: every reported bucket carries its MDE computed from a permutation null whose blocking demonstrably respects the player / game / date dependence, written into the results file beside the result itself. SLICES: identical labels to conditional_edge_design_freeze_v2 — fitting on the earliest available out-of-fold data, 2025 a development check, 2026 retrospective descriptive only, and THE PROSPECTIVE LIVE LOG AS THE ONLY HOLDOUT capable of supporting promotion. Model class, feature cap and degrees-of-freedom limits carry over from that freeze unless a new registration widens them explicitly.

features_desc: C1 MEMBERSHIP AND DIVERSITY. Candidate members: EWMA/ridge incumbent; dynamic hierarchical player-state model; CatBoost; TabPFN; lineup graph model; sequence/time-series model; availability and conditional-minutes model; possession-level simulation; market-implied forecast as an explicit reference member. Diversity means different REPRESENTATIONS and meaningfully different RESIDUAL PATTERNS, never different hyperparameters of one estimator. SCOPE CONFLICT DECLARED: lineup graph, sequence model and possession simulation are listed SCOPE-ONLY / DO-NOT-TEST-YET in PLAN_2026-07-31 section 3. Admitting them is a scope expansion requiring John's decision; until then the council is built from the four bake-off arms plus the availability model plus the market reference, and the report states which members were unavailable and why. C2 TWO COMBINATION FORMS, BOTH TESTED. (a) MODULAR: members assigned to the components they best predict -- LLM extraction supplies timestamped availability EVIDENCE ONLY; an availability model estimates P(active); the hierarchical model estimates ability, form and conditional minutes; a graph model estimates lineup/substitution interaction; CatBoost captures nonlinear tabular interaction; possession simulation converts components into CORRELATED outcome distributions; the market model is an independent price-discovery reference. (b) FORECAST ENSEMBLE: qualified members predict the same outcome distribution and are combined under registered weights. The two may be combined only with a stated justification in the report. C3 MANDATORY COMPARATORS, every council scored against ALL of: best individual model; current incumbent; market forecast; simple equal-weight average; MEDIAN forecast; and best historical single model selected WITHOUT hindsight. BINDING SIMPLICITY RULE: a complicated weighting method that does not beat BOTH equal-weight and median is REJECTED in favour of the simpler combination. C4 WEIGHTING LADDER, tested in increasing complexity: (1) equal; (2) median; (3) nonnegative inverse-error; (4) constrained convex stacking; (5) Bayesian model averaging; (6) regime-aware mixture of experts. Weights are NONNEGATIVE, SUM TO ONE, REGULARISED TOWARD EQUAL, estimated EXCLUSIVELY from chronological out-of-fold predictions, CAPPED so no member dominates without substantial evidence, and FROZEN before the next evaluation period is scored. Negative weights or leverage above one require a SEPARATE registration, because they convert the council into an unstable residual-trading strategy. C5 NO IN-SAMPLE COUNCIL. For every member: generate genuine chronological OUT-OF-FOLD predictions; preserve exact model and data version per prediction; align members on IDENTICAL eligible rows; train weights only from those OOF predictions; score the FROZEN council on later data; and begin a NEW prospective evaluation at any material council change. The choice of which members enter the council is itself model fitting and stays inside development data. C6 DIVERSITY MUST BE MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. Report pairwise residual correlations; error covariance; calibration per member; performance by rotation and availability regime, by player-history depth, and by market and decision cutoff; each member's marginal contribution; LEAVE-ONE-MEMBER-OUT ablations; weight stability across time slices; sensitivity to reasonable weighting constraints; and how often each member supplies the best forecast. A member with worse standalone accuracy may stay ONLY if frozen ablations show complementary errors. C7 REGIME-AWARE COUNCIL. Preregistered regimes: healthy/stable rotation; major availability shock; newly promoted starter; player returning from absence; rookie or sparse history; established high-information player; trade or team change; expansion team; regular season vs postseason; early vs near-tip cutoff. A gating model may vary weights by regime but must be SMALL, REGULARISED, trained only on chronological OOF predictions, and must beat BOTH the best single model AND the fixed-weight council. Independent OPPORTUNITY COUNT and uncertainty reported for every regime; the gate may not manufacture tiny profitable-looking pockets. C8 COMBINE DISTRIBUTIONS, NOT BETTING VOTES. Members emit full predictive distributions or calibrated probabilities, never point estimates or bet recommendations. Forecasts are combined FIRST; then ONE frozen decision layer compares the council distribution with the executable market line, computes EV at recorded odds, applies the uncertainty haircut and exposure constraints, and recommends bet or abstain. Members never vote independently on whether to bet. C9 DISAGREEMENT AS UNCERTAINTY -- CALIBRATED, NOT PRESUMED. Candidate signals: dispersion of predicted points; dispersion of over/under probabilities; disagreement on minutes; disagreement on availability; sensitivity to removing one member; basketball-council-vs-market difference. Each is calibrated against FUTURE error using strictly prior observations. If disagreement does not predict error, it is NOT used as a confidence measure and the report says so. C10 ONLINE WEIGHTS, PREQUENTIAL ONLY. An outcome becomes eligible only after SETTLEMENT; updates use only previously settled observations; updates shrink strongly toward prior weights; per-update movement is CAPPED; every update is LOGGED; no retrospective revision of earlier recommendations, ever. Adaptive weights are compared against permanently frozen weights and retained ONLY if they improve prospective calibration and returns without instability. C11 PROMOTION. The council is promoted only if it beats EVERY mandatory baseline, the best qualified individual model, the equal-weight council, the market benchmark on the registered forecasting metric, AND the incumbent betting policy on the registered prospective decision gate. Judged on forecasting accuracy, calibration, realised ROI, CLV, coverage, drawdown, operational reliability and stability -- never historical ROI alone. features_desc: E1 FIXED NOTIONAL REPLACES LIMITS. Every bet is evaluated at ONE flat notional stake, fixed before any result is viewed, chosen small enough to be plausibly executable on WNBA player props at any book in the sample. REGISTERED VALUE: 100 units (read as USD 100) per bet, flat, no sizing, no Kelly, no scaling by confidence. Reporting is in ROI (return per unit staked), so the absolute unit does not change any conclusion; it is fixed only so the bet count and the notional are unambiguous. E2 CAPACITY IS REPORTED AS UNMEASURED, NEVER AS UNLIMITED. Every result carries the explicit statement that strategy capacity was NOT measured, that real book limits on WNBA player props are materially lower than on major markets, and that realisable profit is therefore bounded by an unmeasured quantity. No result may be expressed as a season profit total, an annualised return, or any figure that implicitly assumes size can be scaled. ROI, bet count and per-bet distribution only. E3 THE ADVERSE-SELECTION CAVEAT IS MANDATORY IN THE REPORT, because it is the reason this gap is not merely conservative. Books cut limits precisely on markets they judge soft, stale or sharp-money-exposed, so limits CORRELATE WITH EDGE and the pockets that look most profitable are disproportionately those on which size is least available. The bias from ignoring limits is therefore SYSTEMATIC AND UPWARD, not random. Any positive finding must state this in the same paragraph as the ROI, not in a footnote. E4 A POSITIVE RESULT IS LABELLED PROVISIONAL. The admissible form of a positive claim is exactly: 'profitable at fixed notional, capacity unmeasured, subject to an upward adverse-selection bias of unknown magnitude.' It may support CONTINUED WORK and a prospective paper-trade cell. It may NOT support a promotion decision, a real-money recommendation, or any statement that the market has been beaten, until an executability source exists. A NEGATIVE result is unaffected and remains fully admissible, because the omission flatters returns: losing under flattering assumptions is robust to the gap. E5 WHAT IS NOT RELAXED, restated so the amendment cannot be read as a general loosening. SIMULTANEITY IS STILL MANDATORY: prices must be verified live via last_update, and stale quotes excluded, with the staleness threshold fixed before results are viewed. This is SATISFIABLE -- last_update is fully populated in master_props_historical.csv (36,946 rows) and merely absent from the derived bet universe, so it is joined back. Also unchanged: a minimum-disagreement band fixed in advance with a meaningful floor in points; overs and unders scored SEPARATELY and never pooled; duplicate and alternate markets handled consistently; side selection fixed; the count of INDEPENDENT player-market opportunities reported rather than quoted rows; an EV threshold fixed before any result is seen; and an MDE beside every reported bucket from a permutation null whose blocking respects player / game / date dependence. Slice labels from conditional_edge_design_freeze_v2 are unchanged and the PROSPECTIVE LOG REMAINS THE ONLY HOLDOUT capable of supporting promotion. E6 ROUTES TO CLOSING THE GAP, recorded so this does not become permanent. (a) Betting exchanges -- Betfair, Novig, Prophet X -- publish order-book DEPTH, a genuine executable-size signal; none are among the nine captured books, and adding one is a real data capability. (b) Empirical discovery by placing small real bets and recording what is accepted; requires accounts and money and is John's decision alone. (c) Any future feed that exposes maximum stake. Whichever arrives first, a re-evaluation under measured limits is a NEW registration.
hypothesis: PROTOCOL AMENDMENT (no predictive claim). AMENDS the EXECUTABILITY clause of calibrated_prob_edge_v1, which is registered but HAS NOT RUN, so this is made before any result exists and consumes no evaluation slice. That clause requires 'book limits applied'. A readiness audit on 2026-08-01 established that book limits are captured NOWHERE and are not obtainable: every key in the props and live-odds payloads was enumerated and an outcome is exactly {description?, name, point, price}. Limits are not published by odds aggregators in general -- they are account-specific, dynamic, and discovered by attempting a bet. An earlier framing that a paid tier would expose them is WITHDRAWN as unsupported. The clause as written is therefore unsatisfiable, and leaving it in place would either block the experiment permanently or invite quiet non-compliance. This record replaces it with a FIXED-NOTIONAL evaluation that is honest about what is and is not known.

results.mechanism: corr(p_over, disagree) = +0.007 while corr(p_over, market implied) = +0.612. The model's own basketball opinion carries essentially no information; the fitted probability is a degraded echo of the line, and the policy then pays vig to bet against the real one.

results.not_the_predecessor_defect: conditional_edge_props_v1 optimised a target maximised by AGREEING with the line. This target, P(points>line), is well posed; the disagreement term was included so its dominance could be MEASURED, and it was: +0.007. The objective was sound and the answer is simply no edge.

The contrast (4) minus (2) is reported as the lower-dimensional companion. ESTIMATOR AND FOLDS. This experiment determines which mechanism label is correct: (A) 'the projection adds no incremental information' or (B) 'the full probability model fails despite some limited projection information'. It changes no threshold, fits no betting policy, and cannot promote anything.

It is the most important addition because it introduces genuinely different information and representation -- shared minutes, substitutions, teammate dependencies, lineup roles, opponent interactions -- and is the best candidate for COMPLEMENTARY residuals rather than another tabular variation. It MAY use a different internal input representation, but it MUST emit predictions for the SAME player-game rows, targets and cutoffs as every other arm. It must beat the incumbent AND add residual diversity. BINDING FAILURE RESPONSE: if effective sample, sequence lengths or missing-history coverage are inadequate, the response is to IMPROVE THE SEQUENCE DATASET OR REPRESENTATION, never to tune a large network until it appears to win. S3 POSSESSION SIMULATION IS A MODULAR DOWNSTREAM LAYER, NOT A WEIGHTED PEER. It is not naturally another forecast member: it CONSUMES component forecasts along availability -> minutes -> usage -> attempts -> shot mix -> conversion and converts them into CORRELATED distributions for player points, team scores, margins and totals. The registered comparison is three-way: (a) direct player-points forecast, (b) modular simulated player-points distribution, (c) direct council plus simulation where justified. BINDING: possession simulation may NOT be averaged with CatBoost as though they were equivalent estimators UNLESS both independently emit the SAME target distribution from the SAME cutoff. S4 THE MARKET IS OUTSIDE THE BASKETBALL COUNCIL. This STRENGTHENS and SUPERSEDES council_design_v1's guard G1, which merely required fitting with and without it. The market is now admitted ONLY as (i) a mandatory benchmark, (ii) a separately reported blend, and (iii) the price in the decision layer. It may NOT be a normal weighted member of the core basketball council. A council that wins by collapsing onto the market has not created a basketball edge. The with-market sensitivity remains DIAGNOSTIC; the PROMOTABLE council must demonstrate independent value WITHOUT it. S5 GRANULARITY CORRECTION -- BINDING, AND IT WITHDRAWS AN ORCHESTRATOR CLAIM. council_design_v1 guard G2 stated that base_predictions_oof_2022_2023_v1 would unblock the council's weighted rungs 3-6. That is WRONG and is WITHDRAWN. Those are GAME-LEVEL margin and total predictions. The council now required is a PLAYER-LEVEL council, whose weights must be trained on chronologically out-of-fold PLAYER-GAME predictions from each player-model arm, aligned on the same player, game, target and cutoff. The OOF extension remains valuable for the game-level conditional-edge line and for a future team/game-distribution council, but it does NOT unblock the player-level weighted rungs. Those stay blocked until S6 exists. S6 SEPARATE, TARGET-SPECIFIC COUNCILS. Predictions for different targets CANNOT be placed into one weight vector; they may feed a modular pipeline but they are not interchangeable council votes. Five councils, each with its own members, weights, comparators and evaluation: (1) P(active); (2) E[minutes | active]; (3) attempts/usage or scoring opportunity; (4) player scoring distribution; (5) team/game distribution. Every mandatory comparator, weighting-ladder constraint, diversity measurement and promotion rule from council_design_v1 applies to EACH council SEPARATELY. S7 THE SHARED ARTIFACT IS A PREDICTION CONTRACT, NOT A FEATURE MATRIX. The shared work produces a common PLAYER-GAME ROW INDEX, a common CUTOFF, and a manifest -- the evaluation universe. Graph and sequence models MAY use different internal inputs; what must be shared is the prediction contract and the evaluation universe, NOT necessarily one literal tabular feature matrix. This amends council_design_v1's 'identical as-of feature matrix' clause, whose intent (identical rows, targets, folds, cutoffs) is preserved while its letter (one literal matrix) would have excluded exactly the representational diversity this amendment exists to admit. S8 PURPOSE CLAUSE, BINDING ON INTERPRETATION. The purpose of adding graph, sequence and simulation is REPRESENTATIONAL DIVERSITY, not increasing the number of models. Any member that fails to add future predictive value or complementary errors REMAINS A RECORDED NEGATIVE RESULT and does NOT receive repeated redesigns against the same slices. S9 EXECUTION ORDER, APPROVED AND BINDING: (1) correct the ledger and the probability-edge mechanism and permutation labels; (2) build the manifest-first player-game as-of prediction contract; (3) generate chronological OOF predictions for incumbent, hierarchical, CatBoost, TabPFN and graph arms; (4) compare individual models BEFORE fitting any council weights; (5) measure residual diversity and leave-one-member-out value; (6) test equal-weight and median councils; (7) ONLY THEN test constrained learned weights; (8) add the compact sequence challenger as the next staged arm; (9) build possession simulation after the component models produce calibrated availability, minutes, volume and conversion distributions; (10) keep collecting prospective core-only predictions WITHOUT altering freeze-v0.

(1) CONSTANT -- training-fold base rate, unfitted. (2) RAW VIG-INCLUSIVE over probability, used DIRECTLY as the prediction, unfitted. (3) DIRECT DE-VIGGED market probability, used DIRECTLY as the prediction, NO fitted recalibration -- this is the fairest unfitted representation of the market. (4) CALIBRATED DE-VIGGED market probability -- one-feature L2 logistic on p_market_devig. (5) PROJECTION ALONE -- disagree. (6) DE-VIGGED MARKET + PROJECTION. All other contrasts are SECONDARY and are reported across multiple specifications and slices WITHOUT family-wise correction, so they may be described only as diagnostic LEADS consistent with a stated interpretation -- never as confirmed general mechanisms.
